name: Talmaria
summary:
Talmaria is a turn-based tactical MMORPG that immerses you in a persistent fantasy world where every battle, every choice, and every adventure matters.

Explore the lands of Talmar, a world divided by the seas, where Order and Chaos coexist in a peace as fragile as it is unlikely.

Choose one of five classes: Warrior, Mage, Priest, Archer, or Rogue. Learn new abilities from class masters and forge your own playstyle with a customizable talent tree built from fragments discovered throughout your adventures.

Face formidable monsters, explore dungeons, and take down powerful bosses alongside other players. Victory must be earned through strategy, teamwork, and tactical decisions.

The adventure is only just beginning.

Talmaria is currently in development. Join the free technical test today, available in both French and English, and be part of the first steps in this emerging world.
